claims.text: Thời Xuân Thu – Chiến Quốc, các nước đánh nhau liên miên

sources.quote: more pronounced during the Warring States period than in the earlier “Spring and Autumn” period (770–481 B.C.E.) ... The Zhou government had been in decline; warfare among the vassal states intensified both in scale and frequency from the fourth century B.C.E. onward.

claims.text: Nho gia dạy lễ nghĩa để sửa đời

sources.quote: The Laozi criticizes the Confucian school not only for being ineffectual in restoring order but more damagingly as a culprit in worsening the ills of society at that time.

claims.text: các nhà mưu lược dạy cách làm nước giàu quân mạnh

sources.quote: Its proclaimed goal was to attain “a rich state and a strong army” ( fu guo qiang bing 富國強兵)
philosophers and strategists, who grew both in number and popularity as a social group or profession during this time, vied to convince the rulers

claims.text: *Đạo đức kinh* đi ngược tất cả: càng can thiệp, càng ham muốn, đời càng rối.

sources.quote: The problems of political decline are broadly traced to excessive desire, a violation of ziran.
artificial effort to “change” people, “improve” things or to “correct” the order of ziran only perpetuates a false sense of self
the Laozi condemns aggressive measures such as war (ch. 30), cruel punishment (ch. 74), and heavy taxation (ch. 75)

claims.text: **Đạo** (道), cái gốc vận hành của muôn vật mà không tên gọi nào bao trọn

sources.quote: Dao is said to be the “beginning” of all things (chs. 1, 25)
the “constant” ( chang ...) Dao cannot be defined or described; it is “nameless.”

claims.text: **vô vi** (無為), hành động không xuất phát từ ham muốn cưỡng cầu

sources.quote: the concept of wuwei seems to be used more broadly as a contrast against any form of action driven by self-serving desire (e.g., chs. 3, 37)

claims.text: **tự nhiên** (自然): cái tự nó như thế

sources.quote: The Laozi makes use of the concept of ziran , literally what is “self ( zi ) so ( ran ),” to describe the workings of Dao.

notes: SEP Laozi (Chan, sửa 22/10/2025) và SEP Legalism (Pines) mở trong phiên. 'Các nhà mưu lược' chỉ chung nhóm thuyết khách/Pháp gia; mục tiêu 'phú quốc cường binh' SEP gán cho các nhà tư tưởng Pháp (fa); cách gọi chung còn chấp nhận được.
